system.description:
You and your allies are computer specialists, capable of penetrating even the strongest electronic defenses.

Prerequisite: Trained in Use Computer

Effect: You gain a +3 competence bonus on Use Computer checks. At the time you make a check, for each ally within 12 squares of you who also has this Feat, the competence bonus increases by +1 (to a maximum of +7).

Additionally, when you use the Aid Another Action to assist an ally who has this Feat with a Use Computer check, you provide a bonus of +4 instead of +2.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy at War
